Kawasaki Adds Smartride Clutch Tech to the 2027 KLE500 for the American Market, Starts at $7,999
13 photos
Photo: Kawasaki
It was earlier in October that Japanese bike maker Kawasaki announced the arrival on the European market of the new model year version of the KLE500 dual-purpose motorcycle, packing the fancy new Smartride system. And now comes confirmation that the new model will be reaching American shores as well.
In Kawasaki speak, Smartride stands for a clever new way for riders to skip using the clutch. In essence, we're dealing with a self-engaging clutch system (Kawasaki’s first) that relies on a mechanical centrifugal clutch fitted inside a conventional assembly.
This setup allows the rider to skip using the clutch when caught in stop-and-go urban traffic. For instance, when the bike's 451cc parallel-twin engine is at idle, the ride can stay put while in gear, without the rider having to pull the clutch lever. When engine speed increases, the starting clutch engages automatically and transfers power to the transmission.
When the motorcycle is moving, though, the starting clutch remains fully engaged, and the rider still has to change gears in the usual fashion.
The arrival of the Smartride system on the American market increases the number of available 2027 Kawasaki KLE500 motorcycles on the U.S. market to three, namely the KLE500 ABS, KLE500 SE ABS, and KLE500 SE Smartride ABS, which now becomes the flagship model of the range.
They all share the same mechanical components, including the trellis frame that holds everything together and the long-travel suspension system. The engine is the same as well, and it comes with no changes or upgrades from before.
The bikes can be propped on spoke wheels (21 inches at the front) shod in tubeless Dunlop Trailmax Mixtour tires. They are tied to a 43 mm KYB cartridge-type inverted fork at the front, delivering 8.2 inches of travel, and the Uni-Trak setup at the rear, allowing for 7.7 inches of travel.
The bikes are fitted with a taller adjustable windscreen now, metal- reinforced hand guards, and a large skid plate to protect the underpinnings. LED lights have been installed all around, and the reinforced rear frame allows for the fitting of two side cases and a top case.
When it comes to keeping riders in the loop with what happens with the bike, that task is handled by a 4.3-inch color TFT display that shows everything from fuel levels to service reminders.
Kawasaki will offer the new KLE500 models starting in November with rally-inspired styling and different colors. You can have a look at what each of them has to offer, including pricing, in the lines below.
2027 Kawasaki KLE500 SE Smartride ABS (Pearl Blizzard White, Metallic Bluish Green) - $7,999 2027 Kawasaki KLE500 ABS (Metallic Carbon Gray / Ebony) - $6,599 2027 Kawasaki KLE500 SE ABS (Pearl Blizzard White, Metallic Bluish Green) - $7,499
